```{r}

```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

college_data <- read_csv(file.choose())

View(college_data)

names(college_data)
```

```{r}
college_clean <- college_data %>%
  select(INSTNM, CONTROL, TUITIONFEE_IN,
         TUITIONFEE_OUT, NPT4_PUB, NPT4_PRIV,
         C150_4)


college_clean <- college_clean %>%
  rename(
    college = INSTNM,
    type = CONTROL,
    in_state_tuition = TUITIONFEE_IN,
    out_state_tuition = TUITIONFEE_OUT,
    public_net_price = NPT4_PUB,
    private_net_price = NPT4_PRIV,
    graduation_rate = C150_4
  )


View(college_clean)
```

```{r}
college_clean <- college_clean %>%
  mutate(
    college_type = case_when(
      type == 1 ~ "Public",
      type == 2 ~ "Private nonprofit",
      type == 3 ~ "Private for-profit",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
cor.test(college_clean$in_state_tuition,
         college_clean$graduation_rate,
         use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
college_clean %>%
  filter(college_type %in% c("Public", "Private nonprofit")) %>%
  group_by(college_type) %>%
  summarise(
    average_graduation = mean(graduation_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    average_tuition = mean(in_state_tuition, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
college_clean <- college_clean %>%
  mutate(
    net_price = case_when(
      type == 1 ~ public_net_price,
      type == 2 ~ private_net_price,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
cor.test(college_clean$net_price,
         college_clean$graduation_rate,
         use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
ggplot(college_clean, aes(x = in_state_tuition,
                          y = graduation_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Does Higher Tuition Mean Higher Graduation Rates?",
    x = "Tuition and Fees ($)",
    y = "Six-Year Graduation Rate"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(college_clean, aes(x = college_type,
                          y = graduation_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Graduation Rates at Public and Private Colleges",
    x = "College Type",
    y = "Six-Year Graduation Rate"
  )
```
